label: Internal audit vs external audit vs self-assessment vs attestation

mentor.diagnosis: You chose a review type without checking who performs it and how independent they must be.
contrast: The team that owns the control
An internal audit function reporting to the audit committee
Independent of the team, not of the organisation
Assurance to management and the board
Assurance to customers, partners and regulators
A signed formal statement that something is true
Evidence a control or condition holds
mentor.rule: The more independent the reviewer, the more weight the result carries outside the organisation. A customer asking for assurance will not accept your self-assessment.
mentor.tell: 'A customer requires evidence before renewing' means an independent third-party audit, not an internal one.
mentor.trap: An internal audit is genuinely independent of the team being audited, which makes it feel sufficient. It is still the organisation auditing itself.

label: Known, partially known and unknown environment testing, and passive vs active reconnaissance

mentor.diagnosis: You mixed up how much the tester was told with what the tester then did.
contrast: Tester is given full information: architecture, credentials, source
Tester is given nothing and must discover it
Gathering information without touching the target: WHOIS, OSINT, social media
Interacting with the target: scanning, enumeration, banner grabbing
mentor.rule: Known, partially known and unknown describe what the tester was told. Passive and active describe whether the target can see the tester.
mentor.tell: 'Simulates an external attacker with no inside knowledge' is unknown environment. 'Without alerting the target or touching its systems' is passive reconnaissance.
mentor.trap: Unknown environment testing usually begins with passive reconnaissance, so the two appear together and get merged. They answer different questions.

mentor.diagnosis: You mixed up how information is gathered with which side of a test is acting.
mentor.rule: Passive and active describe how data is collected. Offensive, defensive and integrated describe who is acting.
mentor.tell: If any traffic reaches the target, it is active. If both teams work together throughout, it is integrated.
mentor.trap: Offensive sounds like active, but they sit on different axes. A tester can be offensive and passive at the same time.
